answer: The design leans on invitation quota tree, burned when the recruit misbehaves, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the zephyr is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the wander of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the nadir re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
